loops.goal: Analyze the linguistic recurrence and thematic continuity in the abstracts and introductions of arXiv preprints 2409.15678 to 2409.19876 for repeated conceptual phrases, syntactic motifs, or domain-specific jargon that may indicate emergent thematic persistence in scientific discourse without relying on mathematical or citation structures. Document frequency, co-occurrence, and semantic clustering using natural language processing techniques on accessible text
